newsitem.title: USA: Loewen Group acquires CMS West.
newsitem.headline: Loewen Group acquires CMS West.

text.p: Loewen Group Inc said Sunday it acquired CMS West, a Pennsylvania-based operator of 28 cemeteries and 7 funeral homes.

The exact the terms of the deal weren't disclosed, but Loewen said it has made nearly $100 million in acquisitions since it received a hostile takeover bid from Service Corp International on September 17.
Vancouver-based Loewen last week rejected a US$2.8 billion unsolicited takeover offer by Service Corp International, which is expected to launch a higher hostile bid this week.

"The acquisition interest we've seen in the last twelve days reflects serious concerns among potential sellers of funeral and cemetery properties about the negative impact SCI's proposed acquisition will have on the market," said Raymond Loewen, chairman and chief executive of Loewen Group.
"The anticompetitive effects of the proposed acquisition have already prompted regulatory scrutiny in several jurisdictions."
Florida's attorney general's office said Friday the state was investigating the anti-trust implications of Service Corp's proposed takeover of Loewen.
